action: Confirm how the bank classifies you
detail: Ask the branch, in writing, whether your account is 境内个人 or 境外个人. The FX Regulations define 境内个人 as a Chinese citizen or a foreigner who has resided in China continuously for one year.

action: Ask for the branch's document checklist
detail: Do not convert first and argue later. Request the written list of documents the branch will accept as proof of the source of funds (salary slips, tax records, sale contract, pension statements).

action: Confirm no tax-recordal form is missing
detail: For outward payments of USD 50,000 equivalent or more in a single payment, a PRC tax-recordal form may be required before the bank remits. Ask whether it applies to your item.

action: Get the all-in quote in writing
detail: Ask for the customer rate, the timestamp, the wire fee, the cable fee, and the statement that overseas bank charges are deducted at cost. Compare with the board rate on the same day.

action: Convert and remit in one instruction
detail: The bank sells you USD at 现汇卖出价 and wires it. Expect the CNY wire fee (0.1%, min 50, max 260) plus the cable fee of CNY 150 to a non-HK destination.

action: Record the rate, because the IRS will need it
detail: Keep the bank's conversion advice. The USD basis of the CNY you disposed of, and today's proceeds, determine the IRC §988 gain on your U.S. return.

action: File the U.S. side on time
detail: If the aggregate of your foreign accounts exceeded USD 10,000 at any point in the year, file FinCEN Form 114. Check Form 8938 thresholds separately. Neither is a tax; both carry penalties.

action: Count the years first
detail: USD 400,000 at USD 50,000 a year is eight calendar years. Confirm you accept that timeline before starting.

action: Convert one slice per calendar year
detail: Use the convenience amount with your ID. Each slice is a separate wire with its own CNY 260 wire fee and CNY 150 cable fee once the amount exceeds about USD 38,864 in CNY terms.

action: Do not borrow anyone else's quota
detail: Using a relative's convenience amount is the exact conduct that lands you on the watch list for the year plus two more, and can attract a 逃汇 fine.

action: Confirm you have actually emigrated
detail: This route needs a cancelled mainland hukou (户籍注销证明) and a certificate of settlement abroad issued or authenticated by a Chinese embassy or consulate.
document: 户籍注销证明, 定居证明

action: Settle PRC tax before cancelling the hukou
detail: The IIT Law requires a tax clearance before a hukou cancellation for emigration. Get the 税收证明 or 完税凭证 — the bank will ask for it.

action: Apply at the FX bureau of your former hukou
detail: Huifa [2014] No. 2 moved approval to the local branch and removed the head-office filing above RMB 500,000.

action: Remit once or in several parts
detail: The requirement to split the payout over two years was repealed in 2014. The bank may pay the approved amount in one or several remittances.

action: Expect the money to go only to your own account abroad
detail: The 2004 rules require the bank to convert and wire directly to your own account in your country of residence; cash payout inside China is not allowed.

action: Check the currency of the balance
detail: If any part of the balance is already USD, move that first: it avoids the 0.21% conversion spread entirely.

action: Wire it out
detail: The wire fee and cable fee still apply; the conversion spread does not.

action: Check the annual ceiling
detail: All your Chinese cards together are capped at RMB 100,000 equivalent of overseas cash per calendar year, and RMB 10,000 per card per day.

action: Withdraw in full-size slices
detail: The BOC fee is CNY 12 + 1% capped at CNY 112 per withdrawal. A RMB 10,000 withdrawal already hits the cap, so smaller withdrawals cost proportionally more.

action: Expect a second, unpublished cost
detail: The card network's conversion rate is not published by the bank. Treat the published 1.12% as a floor, not the whole cost.

action: Buy USD cash at the bank
detail: The board shows the same 现钞卖出价 as the 现汇卖出价 today, so the spread is the same 0.21%.

action: Get the 携带证 above USD 5,000
detail: USD 5,000 or less needs no permit; USD 5,000–10,000 needs a 携带证 from a designated bank; above USD 10,000 is not permitted in principle.

action: Report on the U.S. side
detail: More than USD 10,000 in cash must be reported to CBP on FinCEN Form 105. Failure can mean seizure.
